title: Half-Life 2 in a Browser
summary: A technical project that successfully ported the classic PC game Half-Life 2 to run directly in a web browser using WebAssembly technology, allowing users to play the full game without installation or native software.
problem_solved: Enables running a complex native PC game in a browser environment without requiring local installation or native execution capabilities.
why_valuable: Demonstrates the power of modern web technologies for running demanding applications and makes classic games more accessible through zero-install browser-based deployment.
